reason: I already pay the tuition teacher every month and I trust her to sit with my child in person. If the school makes him do it during the free pilot I will allow it, but I am not adding another monthly payment for more phone time on top of tuition.
objection: More screen time is the last thing my child needs, and an app cannot sit next to him and make sure he actually understands, the way his tuition teacher does.
would_change_my_mind: If the end-of-term re-test shows his gap topics really closed and the class teacher tells me it helped more than tuition did, so I could cut down tuition hours instead of paying for both.
